name: Limestone Ward
description: A chip of Maltese globigerina set in the breastplate.

name: Bastion Ward
description: A chip of Maltese globigerina set in the breastplate.

description: A chip of Maltese globigerina set in the breastplate.

name: Carob Charm
description: Carved from a village tree; the harness feels sturdier.

name: Olive-Wood Charm
description: Carved from a village tree; the harness feels sturdier.

name: Fig-Heart Charm
description: Carved from a village tree; the harness feels sturdier.

name: Luzzu Eye
description: The watchful eye fishermen paint on their boats.

name: Painted Eye
description: The watchful eye fishermen paint on their boats.

name: Ever-Open Eye
description: The watchful eye fishermen paint on their boats.

name: Pilgrim's Shell
description: A scallop shell from a pilgrimage; a steadier aim.

name: Coral Horn
description: A red coral charm against the evil eye.

name: Bizzilla Token
description: A scrap of Gozitan lace, a keepsake from home.

name: Oath Ring
description: Sworn on a blade; the wearer reads an opponent's intent and turns it back on them.

name: Navigator's Medal
description: Struck for the galley pilots of the Order.

name: Grand Master's Favour
description: A token from La Valette himself.

name: Cipher Charm
description: A tin plate scratched with the Order's cipher; it keeps the wearer thinking a step ahead.

name: Cipher Charm II
description: A bronze cipher plate, its marks worn smooth from being checked in the dark.

name: Cipher Charm III
description: A silver cipher plate engraved by the Order's scribes; the wearer answers blows before they land.

name: Scholar's Seal
description: A signet from the Auberge's library. Whoever carries it learns to read a duel like a page.

name: Madonna Medal
description: Struck with Our Lady of Philermos; the wearer shrugs off wounds that would fell another.

name: Kateri's Lucky Spring
description: A wound spring from the first frame Kateri ever rebuilt, fitted into a brass case. It keeps a pilot a half-step ahead.

name: Balbi's Pen
description: A steel pen nib on a leather cord. Balbi swears it has written the names of three hundred dead and never blotted one.

name: Tower Bolt
description: A bolt from the foot of a siege tower, still blackened from the fire. Plates fitted around it do not buckle.

name: Sapper's Lamp
description: A miner's lamp rebuilt as a charm for the boiler. It lights the weak points of whatever you fight.
